log.msg: Schema ready: saves, ledger, brains, conversations, files, Alexandria, Codex
Binding one window manager and one input router
Creating clean renderer and camera lifecycle
Discovering local Ollama without blocking gameplay
Scheduling disk-backed Alexandria and Codex seeding

comments.text: tool tip show tell when we have insufficient funds to purchase something. when something is purchased have a little floating text appear next to the purchase in red or green for the transaction amount in the game then disappear. when buying land, the fence needs to expand and reconnect to form a boundary. plauers should not be allowed to build outside the fence unless owned property. interact mode button can be removed from park manager and ui should show little camera live view of the park entrance. the entrance should have more masonry textures and we should be able to select from 5 different gate options visually. simulation rate should be in a slider in the main ui. network settings should be in its own menu. main ui must expand downwards to show more menus we can click on in the tray. the tooltip must be self aware of the users actions and report the park pulse when user is not moving.  reoverhaul the ui to be darrk mode glass, including the welcome screen and ui should be cinematic and living organic. if you click the guest cap number you can type a static number in.
